boundary_context_difference.explanation: Full-clip context fills the gap; rolling context can classify a trailing tracking loss as neutral absence. Parameters match, outputs can differ.

hand_assignment.shared_extractor: PoseHandsExtractor for offline, GUI, and harness
hand_assignment.label_policy: Swap MediaPipe selfie labels for unmirrored OpenCV input; no coordinate inversion applied.
hand_assignment.fallback: Nearest same-side elbow/shoulder only when handedness unavailable or duplicated.
hand_assignment.dominant_hand_canonicalization: None; left- and right-dominant signing remain distinct inputs.
hand_assignment.limitation: No ground-truth handedness or mirror flag in HDF5; dataset-wide correctness cannot be certified.

findings.issue: Clip-global vs 45-frame hand-presence inference and interpolation context differ at boundaries.
canonicalize_hand_presence can neutralize a real secondary hand detected fewer than max(3, 50% of dominant detections) frames.
Live valid-frame cadence compresses dropped frames; training uses decoded clip cadence. Temporal deltas are not timestamp-normalized.
HDF5 has no extractor version, FPS, processing resolution, mirror flag, or Savitzky-Golay provenance; archived extraction settings are not fully auditable.
Possible handedness flicker in sampled raw training/validation clips.
HELLO and NO contain both left- and right-dominant windows; no dominant-hand canonicalization or mirroring augmentation is applied.
Short offline clips repeat-pad the final frame; live windows contain 45 real extraction steps instead. Identical math does not guarantee identical temporal context.
